content.title: Deep Cavern Exploration
content.body:
Note: The Y coordinates indicate the depth in The Deep Caverns, not the overworld.
    §lImportant Ores
      §l1. §rDiamond Ore (Y = 30-10)
      §l2. §rSilver Ore (Y = 30-10)
      §l3. §rPlatinum Ore (Y = 30-10)
      §l4. §rDevout Crystals (Y = 30-10)
      §l5. §rHeart Crystal Ore (Y = 246-10)
    §lCrystal Agony:
      - Used to craft the next tier of armor. Dropped by the Dweller or Ashen zombie/skeleton variants which spawn at Y = 30.
    §lArmor:
      - Tremor: Diamond
      - Furor: Heavy Diamond
      - Devout: Platinum
      - Arcum: Silver
    §lStructures & loot:
      - Ruined dungeons:
      §l1. §rAncient Tome: When combined with an enchanted book, gives a level higher than the max level of the respective enchant.
      §l2. §rBook of Repairing: Repairs your held item when used in a haunted Decorative Grave.
      §l3. §rBook of Disenchantment: Disenchants your held item when used in a haunted Decorative Grave.
      §l4. §rSummoning Staff
      §l5. §rRune: Cosmetic item that allows for different enchantment glints.
      §l6. §rDevout Crystal Shards, Devout Crystals, and Grand Devout Crystals. 
      §l7. §rHook Shot (Extremely Rare): Let's you grapple to different surfaces and also entities.
      - Flooded dungeons:
      §l1. §rAquatic Saddle (Extremely Rare): Allows you to ride aquatic pets.
      §l2. §rPotions: Depth Strider & Water Breathing.
      §l3. §rFishing Rod of Misadventure
      §l4. §rUnderwater Arrows
      §l5. §rWater-based Enchantments
      §l- Note:§r Mini bosses from this dungeon drop Soulstones, which guarantee an aquatic pet/mount when right-clicked.
